metadata.title: Soft-Focus Retro Portrait with Ornate Framing

retrievalProfile.description: A dreamy 1970s-inspired layout featuring a soft-focus central portrait encased in a thin, ornate white frame with decorative corner flourishes against a muted blue background.
triggerTerms: muted blue and white border design

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition with a wide, dusty-blue outer margin containing a central soft-focus photograph of a person. The photograph is bounded by a thin white double-line frame that features intricate, calligraphic swashes and loops at the corners. The overall mood is ethereal and nostalgic.
coreVisualRelationships: Soft-focus internal image vs. sharp-edged graphic framing
Muted blue background vs. crisp white linework
Ornate top-left and bottom-right flourishes balancing the composition
Wide tracking in the bottom text vs. tight interlocking swashes in the top text
coreInvariants: Decorative corner flourishes with circular loops

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central portrait occupying approximately 60% of the frame width, slightly offset to the right within the inner border.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ornate swash lettering in the top-left corner and the corresponding flourish in the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left ornate text, moves through the soft-focus face, down to the wide-tracked text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial blue margin around the central frame creates a sense of calm and focus.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft blonde and pale blue (within the photograph)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value white accents for clarity.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Interlocking glyphs with heavy, rounded swashes and double-line outlines.
Bottom text: Ultra-thin, high-waisted sans-serif with extreme letter spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters with extended tails that loop into the frame
Letters that overlap and share strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, heavy interlocking display text paired with airy, minimalist wide-tracked sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative curves and interlocking potential.
Matches the clean, airy feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a wide muted-blue border. Inside, place a thin white double-line frame with ornate calligraphic loops at the corners. The center should contain a soft-focus, low-contrast portrait of a person with blonde hair in a striped shirt, appearing slightly hazy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom double-outlined swash lettering in the top-left corner, overlapping the frame. Add a single line of ultra-thin, wide-tracked uppercase sans-serif text centered at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the central image soft-focus and hazy?
Does the frame have thin double-lines and ornate corner flourishes?
Is the top text interlocking with swashes?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean, precise linework for the frame

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white frame lines are thin and consistent.
Ensure the portrait does not have sharp edges.
Verify the blue background is desaturated and muted.
Confirm the top-left text uses a double-line outline style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Muted blue margin + thin ornate white frame + soft-focus portrait + 70s swash typography.
